_how_to: Add one entry per real customer review. stars 1-5. image: customer photo in public/images or empty. verified: true for people who bought from you (including last year). Reviews customers leave on Whop are added automatically.
_happy_customers_how_to: Total customers who bought this product from you, from your order records. Shown at the top as Loved By N+ <noun>.
_recent_orders_how_to: Orders from your other store(s) in a 24h window: count + when that window started (ISO). The pill shows N+ orders in the last 24h until 24h after "at". Whop orders are counted automatically.
